move_index_note: divmot99 has no move-index section (section 2 size 0). Branch targets in common rows and in branch_blocks resolve through the ACTIVE character bank's move_index (engine: MoveBranchStep -> move_lookup via the fighter's bank).
branch_blocks_note: Shared branch lists spliced in by <common> CALL records (cmd 0xC00C). Stored in the game EXE at VA 0x80017C78 (SLUS_004.02 file offset 0x8478); block = entry-count records followed by a RETURN (0xC00D) record. Key = start record index in that table.
